title: Lego Build of Waterfall City
content: Brick E. McBrickface created this motorized Lego build of Waterfall City."At 2,650 pieces and measuring 27x40 cm, this build is designed at a realistic scale for production.""The set can be displayed from any angle as a collector's piece, while the playable features invite interaction."Technic lovers will appreciate the 33 gears, 36 treads, and various axles included.""Animating the scene is a single Powered Up Move Hub which activates a hidden system of gears and treads that simultaneously drive the flowing river, 3 rolling falls, and the spinning One World Globe and the waterway passage underneath it."Previously:Building Dinotopia in LegoLego-Powered Dolly
